intent: Add the A5 B-I combined MXFP4-NoPE raw key record while preserving all post-V0 behavior.
out_of_scope: Full-D=576 MXFP4 and a separate scale gather path.
Changes to sparse routing, S2/G partitioning, BMM1, softmax, BMM2, V1, or V2.

reference.use_decision: simple-new clean-room implementation; existing QSFA source is inspected for integration only and is not copied into the oracle

oracle.type: Python clean-room decoder for the owner-approved B-I record

inputs.name: key
shapes: per logical KV token storage width is exactly 400 bytes: [256B packed FP4 E2M1 NoPE][128B raw Q_T RoPE][16B E8M0]

inputs.name: value
inputs.mutation: read-only; unchanged A5 MLA V0 does not use it

inputs.name: sparse_indices
shapes: one topK row per logical (B,S1), sparse_block_size=1

inputs.name: key_dequant_scale
inputs.mutation: read-only compatibility input; not numerical in B-I V0

outputs.name: attention_out
shapes: existing output shape; unchanged by B-I
outputs.mutation: newly allocated output; no input aliases

errors: Reject A5 B-I key storage width other than 400 bytes.
Reject A5 B-I sparse_block_size other than 1.
Reject E8M0 scale byte 0xff in the B-I oracle; raw-cache production is outside this change, and the kernel maps any 0xff scale that reaches it to bf16 NaN.
Retain existing required-input validation for combined quant-scale mode.
aliasing: attention_out MUST NOT alias query, key, value, sparse_indices, or any scale input.
The B-I path does not mutate any input cache record or metadata tensor.
state_mutation: The B-I path adds no state mutation.
key_dequant_scale remains a compatibility input and is not numerical state for B-I V0.

requirement_bindings.requirement: RoPE preservation and V0 output compatibility

supported_cases: A5 B-I key records with 256B packed FP4 E2M1 NoPE, 128B raw BF16/FP16 RoPE, and 16B valid E8M0 scales.
BSND, TND, and PA row selection with sparse_block_size=1.
V0 UB batches containing 1 through 16 gathered KV records.
unsupported_cases: Separate FP4 data and E8M0 scale gather.
Key records with a storage width other than 400 bytes or an E8M0 0xff scale byte.
